q: What did Mordecai say would happen if Esther remained silent at that time?
a: For if you, indeed, remain silent at this time, relief and deliverance will arise for the Jews from another place, but you and the house of your father will perish.

q: About what did Haman’s wise men and his wife warn him?
a: If Mordecai, before whose face you have begun to fall, is from the seed of the Jews, then you will not prevail against him, but you will surely fall before his face.
